newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Sep ind prod falls 1.3 pct excl contruction.
newsitem.headline: French Sep ind prod falls 1.3 pct excl contruction.

text.p: National statistics institute INSEE said on Friday industrial production, excluding construction, fell 1.3 percent in September from July/August and was up 0.7 percent year-on-year. Industrial production excluding energy, agri-food businesses and construction -- considered by INSEE the best measure of manufacturing output -- fell 2.0 percent in September from July/August, giving a year-on-year rise of 1.0 percent.
It gave the following seasonally adjusted data based on a new index introduced in January 1996.
The previous index used a base year of 1985.

NOTE - Comparison with year-ago period is for three months to end Sept versus the three months in the same period last year. INSEE said on October 22 that industrial production excluding construction rose 1.9 percent in July/August and industrial production excluding energy, agri-food business and construction rose 2.9 percent in July/Aug from June.
